Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our discussion, we'd like to set up a joint technical session with our Solutions Engineering team to walk through:

- End-to-end inference flow for the model variants you're considering
- Latency/cost tradeoffs (quantization + batching) for your 1–5k TPS read pattern
- Network/credentials pattern for a Private deployment and required firewall ports
- High-level SOC 2 artifacts and where they map to the procurement questionnaire

Proposed structure (90 minutes total): 45m SE demo + 30m procurement/contract Q&A + 15m security deep-dive.

Possible windows (EST):
- Thu 2026-12-09 16:00–17:30 EST
- Fri 2026-12-10 11:00–12:30 EST

If those don't work, please send 2–3 times that fit your team's calendar (we'll try to accommodate Jin and procurement). I've attached a short demo agenda and a preliminary pricing estimate so procurement has something to review ahead of time.

Dev and Ben — looping you in to confirm SE availability and if you'd want to tweak the agenda. Security team, the attached SOC2 redacted summary should address most of the initial questions; happy to surface more detail in the session.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett

Thanks. Both windows look reasonable on our side but our engineering team prefers late afternoons PST. Can we aim for Fri 12/10 after 15:00 PST (that would be 18:00 EST) instead?

Thanks Laura, and hi Samir —

We can absolutely run the session. Quick notes from SE perspective:

- We prefer a split agenda: 30–40m live walk-through of an inference trace (latency breakdown + KV cache behavior) followed by a 30m architecture Q&A where we deep-dive into your network and auth patterns.
- For a productive session, could Jin share a short network diagram (VPC/subnet + NAT/GW pattern) and the expected model sizes (8B/70B) you plan to evaluate? A sample request/response schema (or example prompt) is helpful so we can replicate latency within the demo.
- Availability: I can do Thu 12/09 16:00–17:30 EST or Fri 12/10 18:00–19:30 EST (that's the 15:00 PST window Samir suggested). Ben can join both slots as backup.

If procurement needs a separate 30m slot to go through the pricing spreadsheet, we can extend the invite or create a follow-up.

Cheers,
